info.name: Stock Management System API
info.description: Complete Postman collection for Stock Management System API. Includes Authentication, RBAC, Users, Products, Variants, Approval Workflow, Direct Operations, Excel Import/Export, Stock Adjustments, Notifications, and Reports.

item.name: 00. System & Database Health (/health)
item.description: Production health checks for PostgreSQL database connectivity, ping latency, memory consumption, active connection pool, and system uptime.

request.description: Returns system status, uptime, memory consumption, and database connectivity.
Returns PostgreSQL latency in ms, table count, database disk size, active connections, and PostgreSQL engine version.

item.name: 16. Customer Orders & Telegram (/customer-orders)
item.description: Complete Telegram Mini App ordering system. Includes customer authentication with Telegram initData, customer registration, staff approvals, order checkout, customer responses, multi-stage order review, delivery tracking, and cash on delivery payments.

request.description: Verifies Telegram initData HMAC signature. Returns REGISTRATION_REQUIRED for new users, ACTIVE with JWT token for approved customers, or PENDING/REJECTED/SUSPENDED/BLOCKED status.

request.description: Submits partner business information. Automatically links to Telegram account. Checks for phone/company duplicates and sets status to PENDING waiting for staff review.

query.description: Telegram username, Telegram user ID, company name, contact, or phone

query.description: Filter: PENDING, ACTIVE, REJECTED, SUSPENDED, BLOCKED
Search company, contact name, or phone

request.description: Staff/Admin endpoint to view partner registrations with their associated Telegram accounts.
Approves a PENDING customer registration. Sets status to ACTIVE, enables ordering, and automatically notifies customer via Telegram Bot.
Rejects a customer registration with a required reason. Automatically sends a notification to the customer on Telegram with the reason and allows them to edit & resubmit in the Mini App.

Creates a new order from Mini App cart. Generates human-readable orderNo (ORD-YYYYMMDD-XXXX). Fetches official unit prices from DB. Sets status to PENDING_REVIEW. Dispatches Telegram notification to customer and internal Mail to staff.

query.description: Optional filter by status

request.description: Returns paginated orders belonging strictly to the authenticated customer.
Returns order details, items, negotiation messages, and payment records for the customer. Strictly validates ownership.
Customer accepts the available partial quantity. Deducts accepted quantity from warehouse stock, updates approvedQuantity, and sets status to CONFIRMED.

item.name: Customer Response: ⏳ Wait for All Stock (WAIT_STOCK)

request.description: Customer chooses to wait for all requested units. Sets order status to WAITING_STOCK, approvedQuantity to 0, waitingQuantity to requested quantity, does not deduct stock now, and queues the order.
Customer rejects and cancels the order. Sets order status to CANCELLED and releases any reserved inventory.
Customer sends a free-text message/inquiry. Logs message to order history and notifies staff without manipulating stock directly.
Allows a customer to cancel an order that is still in review/negotiation stage.

query.description: PENDING_REVIEW, WAITING_CUSTOMER, CONFIRMED, WAITING_STOCK, PROCESSING, OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, DELIVERED, COMPLETED, REJECTED, CANCELLED
Search orderNo or customer name

request.description: Returns all customer orders with customer relations and item details for staff dashboard.

item.name: Create Order by Staff (For Existing Customer)

request.description: Allows sales/staff to place an order directly on behalf of an existing ACTIVE customer. Uses same customer_orders and customer_order_items tables. Status is immediately CONFIRMED, stock is locked and deducted, and customer is notified via Telegram.
Returns single customer order with full item, message, and payment history.
Staff accepts the order. If full stock is available, sets status to PROCESSING and reserves inventory. Notifies customer on Telegram.

Staff asks customer a question regarding partial availability (e.g. Requested 200, Available 100). Transitions status to WAITING_CUSTOMER and sends interactive Telegram buttons: [⚡ Get Available Now (100)], [⏳ Wait for All (200)], [❌ Cancel].
Staff rejects the customer order. Status becomes REJECTED and customer is notified via Telegram Bot.
Sets approved and waiting quantities. Strictly enforces invariant: approvedQuantity + waitingQuantity <= requestedQuantity.
Verifies and deducts stock from warehouse for approved items. Transitions status to PROCESSING.

item.name: Update Delivery Status - Out for Delivery

request.description: Marks order as OUT_FOR_DELIVERY. Dispatches Telegram notification to customer with driver information.
Marks order deliveryStatus as DELIVERED. Customer is notified to pay cash on delivery.
Records cash collected from customer. Sets paymentStatus to PAID and logs staff member who collected it.
Finalizes the customer order. Status transitions to COMPLETED. Telegram completion confirmation sent to customer.
